Definition
[Geodesic half-spaces and Busemann sublevels] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0480 ↗ def:chow-iii-i1-rays-busemann 1. appi:1.5\group Busemann geometry

For $\gamma \in \Ray _{\M }(p)$ set \[ \mathbb B_\gamma =\bigcup _{s>0}B(\gamma (s),s),\qquad \mathbb H_\gamma =\M \setminus \mathbb B_\gamma , \] and write $\gamma _s(u)=\gamma (u+s)$. Define \[ C_s(p)=\bigcap _{\gamma \in \Ray _{\M }(p)}\mathbb H_{\gamma _s}. \]
